title: Business Silver Rewards Card: How to File a Travel Insurance Claim
summary: Explains how to file a travel insurance claim for the Business Silver Rewards Card by confirming the trip was charged to your card and covered, gathering required documentation (itineraries, receipts, carrier notices, medical reports if applicable, proof of out-of-pocket expenses), and submitting the correct claim form to the claims administrator. Approved claims are reimbursed up to $15,000 per trip, and you must respond promptly to any additional information requests.
